Grammar and structure for the Writing Task

The following are examples of useful and appropriate structures for
you to use in your referral letters.

INTRODUCTION

Thank you for seeing ____, a 25 year old patient, who first came to
see me on _____, complaining of (noun), accompanied by (noun).

I am referring _______, a six year old boy, who first presented on
____, with complaints of (noun).

Thank you for seeing _______, an elderly pensioner, whom I first
saw on _______, suffering from a bout of ____________.

HISTORY

     He has had symptoms of __________.
     She has been suffering from ________.
     She has been experiencing her first bout of _________.

     He is a smoker.

     She has a five year history of _________ (chronic illness),
      which is well-controlled by diet and exercise.


EXAMINATION

Active variation                   Passive variation

On examination, I found            ___________ was found on
_______________. (more             examination.
typical)                           On examination, the patient was
                                   found to be _________


On examination, the patient was
________, _________ and
_____________. (adjectives)


Examination revealed / showed /
indicated / _________ (nouns)
OR that the patient has
___________ (nouns) or disease
 
/ condition.


_____test(s) indicated / showed
___________ / that the patient
is suffering from / has
________.


Further investigation revealed /
showed / indicated that
_____________________.

There were no remarkable             .
findings on (abdominal)
examination / in urine analysis.
Otherwise, the patient was
normal.
There was no evidence of any         No abnormality was found /
abnormality.                         detected.
Examination was unremarkable,
apart from (some positive
finding).


TREATMENT

Active variation                     Passive variation
                                     The patient was given Drug for
I gave the patient Drug for the      the pain.
pain.

                                 The patient was commenced on
I commenced the patient on drug. drug.

I prescribed drug for the pain.      Drug was prescribed for his / her
                                     pain. / The patient was
                                     prescribed drug.
                                     The patient was initially treated
I treated him/ his condition with    with drug.
drug.
                                     Intravenous fluids were
I administered intravenous           administered.
fluids.
I ordered blood tests.               Blood tests were ordered.
                                     The patient was advised to take
I advised the patient to take drug   drug for the pain.
 
for the pain.

                                     The patient was advised to
I advised the patient to modify      modify his / her lifestyle.
his / her lifestyle OR lose weight
/ stop smoking.

                                     It was suggested to the patient
I suggested (that) the patient       that she lose weight. (bit formal)
reduce his consumption of
cigarettes / his alcohol
consumption.
                                     Bedrest and hotpacks were
I recommended bedrest and            recommended for his condition.
hotpacks for his condition.

                                     ________ was taken for the
The patient took ______ for the      pain.
pain.
The patient was on / has been on ________ for his pain.
His current medications include: / are :


CONCLUSION

     I would appreciate your urgent assessment of this patient.
     Would you please examine Mrs X and recommend appropriate
      treatment.
    Could you please arrange to admit Mr _____ and follow up
      with appropriate treatment.
    Could you please discuss his / her management with Mr / Mrs
      ______ and advise as to the best course of action from here.
Should you require any further information regarding this patient.
please do not hesitate to contact me.
